[[File:Virdugo_Plunge.png|thumb|right|250px|The Virdugo Plunge and the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]].]]

'''Virdugo Plunge''' was one the waterfalls making the end of the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]] in the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] capital city of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. It was the largest waterfall of Theed.

The Virdugo Plunge was located near the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]].
